name: Heritage Craft

intent_defaults.description: A craft- and heritage-inspired starting point in which the user supplies the cultural references, motifs, techniques and permissions they want to incorporate.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-defined contemporary, traditional or hybrid silhouette.

component_defaults.motifs: Only user-authored or rights-cleared motifs and references
component_defaults.textile: User-selected weave, knit, embroidery or surface technique
component_defaults.finishing: Craft-specific finishing defined with the maker
component_defaults.provenance: Record source, permissions and maker attribution where supplied

accessibility_defaults: All fit, closure, coverage and material choices remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Offer repair, alteration and modular-replacement options where compatible with the wearer intent.
caveats: The system must not treat cultural motifs or techniques as generic assets or infer permission to use them.
Cultural attribution, community permissions and maker credit require human-provided and independently reviewed information.
